One year of teaching experience at the polytechnic level. 2. A Bachelor's degree in the appropriate branch. 3. In addition to the above minimum eligibility, the criteria of the respective QIP center must be fulfilled. > **2. For Ph.D. Program in Engineering/Management:** - Full-time regular/permanent faculty members of AICTE approved Degree Level institutes having 1. Three years of teaching experience at graduate-level institutes. 2. A Master's degree in the appropriate branch. 3. In addition to the above minimum eligibility, the criteria of the respective QIP center must be fulfilled. - **NOTE:** All the eligibility for applying for the programme will be counted as on the last date of submission of the application as notified in the advertisement.
